extDescription.message: Captures the LinkedIn profile you choose, when you press Capture, and sends it to your Scouty workspace. Never acts on LinkedIn.

overlayFixedLine.message: Scouty is reading this page. It won't click or post anything.

permissionBody.message: Scouty needs your permission to read LinkedIn profile pages you choose to capture, and to send them to your Scouty workspace.

signedOutTitle.message: Capture a LinkedIn profile into Scouty

signedOutBody.message: This extension only reads, and only when you press Capture.

connectingBody.message: Finish signing in in the window that opened.

notOnProfileBody.message: Go to someone's profile on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/…), then click this icon.

consentPoint1.message: Scouty reads this profile and this person's recent posts, comments and reactions from this tab, and sends them to your workspace.

consentPoint2.message: It only reads. It never clicks Follow, Like, Connect or Message, never posts, and never reads your LinkedIn password, cookies or messages.

consentPoint3.message: Opening a profile counts as a profile view, which this person may see. Tools like this are against LinkedIn's terms and LinkedIn may restrict your account.

recentBody.message: You can use what Scouty already has, or read the profile again.

sendingBody.message: Keep this browser open for a moment.

sendingSlow.message: Still sending. Your connection seems slow.

partialBody.message: Scouty will work with what it has and tell you what's missing.

notExpandedBody.message: Long posts were not opened in full, because LinkedIn is shown in a language Scouty doesn't expand yet.

clickLogTitle.message: Development build: controls pressed on LinkedIn ($1)

clickLogNone.message: Development build: nothing was pressed on LinkedIn.

linkedinSignInBody.message: You're not signed in to LinkedIn in this browser. Sign in on linkedin.com, then press Capture again. Nothing was sent.

verificationBody.message: Capture has stopped. Complete LinkedIn's check yourself, and wait until LinkedIn is back to normal before capturing again.

unavailableBody.message: LinkedIn is showing a limited version of this profile, or it isn't available to you.

addressChangedTitle.message: LinkedIn shows this person at a different address

offlineBody.message: Scouty will finish sending as soon as you're back online. Keep the browser open.

notAnsweringBody.message: Your capture is kept in this browser. Scouty will keep trying to send it while this browser is open.

notAnsweringRetryAt.message: Scouty asked to wait a little. The next try is at about $1.

connectionEndedBody.message: Your connection ended. Connect within a few minutes to finish sending this capture.

limitBody.message: Your workspace has used today's captures. More are available after $1.

limitBodyLater.message: Your workspace has used today's captures. More are available later.

outdatedBody.message: This version is too old to capture. Update it, then try again.

notAvailableBody.message: LinkedIn capture isn't switched on for your Scouty account.

suppressedBody.message: Scouty doesn't keep information about this person.

failedBody.message: Nothing was saved. Press Capture again.

takenOverBody.message: It was started again from another browser or device, or removed in Scouty. Nothing more from this capture will be sent.

takenOverNext.message: To read this profile again from here, press Capture here.
